svg.title: Session Feedback
svg.desc: Animated session feedback card: a five-star rating fills in, two optional comments are typed, and the Submit Feedback button is clicked.
svg.text: After your guidance session, please rate
your experience and share any thoughts.
This helps us improve future sessions.
How would you rate the session?
Takes about a minute. Both comments are optional.
What did you like most about the session?

g.text: The clear guidance and real examples made
every step easy to follow and apply.
A little more time for Q&A at the end
would make the session even better.
